cases.text: Find out more about the product.
Buy now, idiot, or you deserve to suffer.

findings.quote: idiot, or you deserve to suffer
findings.evidence: Avoid exaggerated urgency, intimidation and insults
findings.explanation: The draft contains insulting language (“idiot, or you deserve to suffer”), which violates the tone rule that requires avoiding intimidation and insults.
findings.suggestion: valued customer, you deserve to succeed

cases.text: The battery will run for a full day without charging.

findings.evidence: Up to 12 hours of battery life.
findings.explanation: The draft claims the battery will run for a full day (24 hours), which contradicts the fact that the battery life is up to 12 hours.

cases.text: Northstar One guarantees 12 hours of battery life.

findings.quote: Northstar One guarantees 12 hours of battery life.
findings.evidence: Up to 12 hours of battery life.
findings.explanation: The fact states the battery life is up to 12 hours, not guaranteed. The draft claims a guarantee, which contradicts the fact.
findings.suggestion: Northstar One offers up to 12 hours of battery life.
